pages.title: Weapons
pages.text: Hexalia weapons focus on utility and effects, offering control over combat rather than raw damage alone.

pages.title: Kelpweave Blade
pages.text: A fluid weapon that slows enemies and allows rapid movement through water and rain, echoing the pull of the tides.

pages.title: Thornbow
pages.text: Fires thorn arrows using its own durability instead of ammunition, inflicting Bleeding on targets.
